name: Chinese Beef and Broccoli Rice Bowls

components.name: Beef in Sauce

ingredients.name: Flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain
Cornflour / cornstarch (1½ tsp marinade + 2½ tbsp slurry)
Neutral oil (2 tsp marinade + 3 tbsp cooking)
Low-sodium chicken stock or water (⅔ cup)

steps: Slice beef across the grain. Mix it with a spoonful of soy, some cornstarch and a little water; set aside about 15 minutes.
Stir-fry beef in two batches in a hot wok with a little oil, moving only after it browns on one side.
Cook garlic and ginger briefly, pour in stock, soy, oyster sauce, sugar and remaining cornstarch slurry; simmer until shiny.
Return beef and broccoli to the sauce and toss only until evenly coated.

components.name: Broccoli
steps: Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 60–90 seconds and drain; it should remain bright green and slightly firm.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Rinse and cook jasmine rice. Set aside for rapid portioning.
Keep rice separate from the sauced beef and broccoli to limit sogginess. For the best texture eat in the first 2–3 days.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Freezer: Cooked beef and sauce freeze; broccoli turns soft when thawed.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
